explanation: OEIS A185150 (number of odd primes p in (n², (n+1)²) with (n/p) = 1), Z.-W. Sun: 'Conjecture: a(n)>0 for all n>0.' The formal a counts odd primes in the open interval with jacobiSym n p = 1, which equals the Legendre symbol for odd primes p. The statement 0 < a(n) for n > 0 matches. Faithful.
